primary_claim: Evolutionary prompt optimization (EPO) can find human-readable prompts that activate SAE features more strongly than any example in a large dataset of activations, and can preserve interpretable feature structure

effect.metric: SAE feature activation vs dataset max-activating examples
effect.value: EPO prompts exceed activation of all 24576 dataset examples (GPT-2)

contradicts_or_qualifies: AdvPrompter, tried as an alternative approach, did not work for maximizing arbitrary SAE features in their tests
stated_future_work: Develop an AdvPrompter-like approach that could generalize better and sample a distribution of prompts maximizing a feature rather than only finding peaks
limitations_stated: Could not get EPO to maximize two features at once with a reasonable fluency penalty
Not evaluated in traditional settings like jailbreaking
Impractical for generating large amounts of data or caching many features at once
Some highest-activating generations exploit tokens with high direct logit effect rather than truly reflecting the feature
quote: We find prompts that activate features more than any dataset examples for GPT-2 (24576 prompts of 128 tokens).
